response.sql:
WITH race_driver_standings AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.round, c.country, ds.driverId, ds.wins as current_wins
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
),
driver_wins_at_race AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, round, country, driverId,
    current_wins - COALESCE(LAG(current_wins) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driverId ORDER BY round), 0) as wins_at_race
  FROM race_driver_standings
),
avg_wins_per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId, country, AVG(wins_at_race) as avg_wins_at_race
  FROM driver_wins_at_race
  GROUP BY raceId, country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins_at_race) as country_average
  FROM avg_wins_per_race
  GROUP BY country
),
overall_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_average) as benchmark FROM country_avg
),
filtered_countries_1 AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.country_average
  FROM country_avg ca CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark
  WHERE ca.country_average > overall_benchmark.benchmark
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_average) as mean_value FROM filtered_countries_1
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT fc.country, fc.country_average,
    fc.country_average - ob.benchmark as above_benchmark,
    fc.country_average - sm.mean_value as above_second_mean
  FROM filtered_countries_1 fc CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark ob CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
  WHERE fc.country_average > sm.mean_value
)
SELECT country, country_average, above_benchmark, above_second_mean FROM final_result ORDER BY country;

assumptions.assumption: Round numbers sequence monotonically within each season; LAG(current_wins) OVER (... ORDER BY round) correctly identifies the wins from the driver's previous race in that season, which may have been at a different circuit.
Every driver who finishes a race (or competes in the official standings) has a driverStandings entry for that race. 'Driver standings' refers to the driverStandings table, not the results table.
Country names in circuits.country are unique identifiers for geographic grouping; no races are reassigned between countries in the dataset.
